title: His movie debut in 'Hotel' playing tambourine
summary: In 1966 he played tambourine in the film with Sidney Key on banjo and Blakeney on trumpet.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Right. And then in 1966 you were in a movie, "Hotel."
That was at the hotel -- hotel -- yeah. Hotel, what they call it?
Oh, I see, who was that?

I come along with the tambourine, pap-pap-pap-pap- and walk up and holding on it -- they'd throw money in the tambourine. I'd -- I'd say, don't forget that's my 50 cents, you give me my 50 cents. -- say what're you doing there. Hey cut that out, don't forget my 50 cents.
I'm supposed to turn and you know, but give them guys the money back --
We go along, we supposed to be along the street, you know --
They walking along, I come in and pour something in the tambourine.
Was that your debut as a movie star?
